Coverage_Description: Network dental plan (K21/K12): scaling & polishing (K21: 1 visit; K12: 2 visits), unlimited oral check-up/hygiene instruction, intra-oral X-ray and fluoride when needed, caries fillings, simple extraction, emergency pain relief, non-surgical absc; excludes specialist care, OPG/CT/Lateral Ceph imaging, wisdom/surgical/orthodontic extractions, and non-caries fillings
pricing: Annual plan fee amount not shown; member preferential rates for non-covered services, e.g., further scaling HK$350 (list HK$650), additional fillings HK$450+ (list HK$650-750+), root canal HK$3,600-4,500+, tooth whitening HK$3,500-6,930.
customer requirement: Eligible employees and eligible dependents; enrolment subject to Health & Care approval/confirmation
price structure: Full annual fee charged even for mid-year joiners; fee is non-refundable and non-transferable
additional informations: Plan term 1 Jul 2025-30 Jun 2026; unused items forfeited at expiry with no extension; scaling appointments via hotline and should be booked at least 2 months before plan end
